result.stdout:
USAGE:
    mcs [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    mcs init --prefix Acme
    mcs create-app --name Shop --database shop
    mcs create-domain -s Shop -n Orders --models --tests
    mcs create-app-lib -s Shop -n Processors --tests
    mcs create-lib --name Events --tests

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init              Set the current directory up as a MagicCSharp repository  
    create-app        Create a service                                          
    create-domain     Create a domain inside a service                          
    create-app-lib    Create a library inside one service                       
    create-lib        Create a shared library under Libs/                       
    add-entity        Create an entity and its repository                       
    sync              Rebuild the all-projects solution from disk               
    validate          Lint the conventions the compiler cannot                  
    references        Print every project a project depends on, directly or not 
    affected          Print the apps a range of commits changed, for CI to build
                      and deploy                                                
    update            Bring files mcs ships up to this version                  
    templates         See and override the templates the generators use

DESCRIPTION:
Set the current directory up as a MagicCSharp repository

USAGE:
    mcs init [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    mcs init --prefix Acme

OPTIONS:
                                       DEFAULT                                  
    -h, --help                                    Prints help information       
    -p, --prefix <PREFIX>                         Namespace and solution-name   
                                                  root, e.g. 'Acme' gives       
                                                  Acme.Shop.slnx                
        --package-version <VERSION>               MagicCSharp version to pin in 
                                                  Directory.Packages.props      
        --target-framework <TFM>       net10.0    Target framework for the      
                                                  repository's projects         
        --no-build-rules                          Leave out                     
                                                  MagicCSharp.Analyzers, the    
                                                  code-style rules every project
                                                  otherwise builds with         
        --no-ai-knowledge                         Leave out AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md
                                                  and .ai-knowledge/, the       
                                                  conventions written for AI    
                                                  coding agents

DESCRIPTION:
Create a service

USAGE:
    mcs create-app [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    mcs create-app --name Shop --database shop

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -n, --name <NAME>            Service name, one PascalCase word, e.g. 'Shop' 
    -d, --database <DATABASE>    Database name, lowercase with underscores.     
                                 Implies data projects                          
        --no-database            Create no data projects — for a service that   
                                 owns no tables                                 
    -p, --port <PORT>            Local development port. Defaults to one no     
                                 other service has claimed

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Create an entity and its repository

USAGE:
    mcs add-entity [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    mcs add-entity -s Shop -d Orders -n Order --paginated

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -s, --solution <SERVICE>    Which service, e.g. 'Shop'. Omit when the       
                                repository has only one                         
    -n, --name <NAME>           Entity name in PascalCase, e.g. 'Order'         
    -d, --domain <DOMAIN>       Owning domain, e.g. 'Orders'. Dots for a        
                                subdomain: 'Orders.Fulfilment'                  
    -k, --use-key               Key by an unguessable string instead of a       
                                Snowflake id. Use when the key is public        
    -p, --paginated             Also give the repository page-at-a-time reads

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Print the apps a range of commits changed, for CI to build and deploy

USAGE:
    mcs affected [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    mcs affected --base origin/master --json

OPTIONS:
                           DEFAULT                                              
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -b, --base <COMMIT>               The commit to compare against: the pull   
                                      request's base, or the last deployed      
                                      commit                                    
        --head <COMMIT>    HEAD       The commit to compare. Defaults to HEAD   
        --solution                    Count every project in the app's solution,
                                      tests included, not only what the app     
                                      ships                                     
        --all                         Print every app, ignoring what changed.   
                                      For a manual full deploy                  
        --json                        Print a JSON array of names, ready for a  
                                      GitHub Actions matrix
